# World Bank Data Topics

> > The World Bank's specialized data portal providing global datasets on consumption patterns, household spending, waste management, and development economics for researchers and policymakers.

World Bank Data Topics aggregates critical development datasets including household consumption data from developing countries, solid waste management trends, and market intelligence for low-income segments. The platform serves as a central hub for accessing World Bank's specialized research databases and analytical tools.

## Key Topics

- Global Consumption Database
- Household Consumption
- Developing Countries
- Solid Waste Management
- Market Analysis
- Low-Income Segments
- Household Spending
- Business Intelligence
- Data Dashboard
- Poverty Economics
- Global Database
- Waste Generation
- Market Data
- PPP (Purchasing Power Parity)
- Microdata Library

## Consumption & Household Economics

- [Global Consumption Database](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/consumption/): Dashboard providing household expenditure data, spending patterns, and market analysis for developing countries with focus on low-income segments
- [Global Consumption Database - Home](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/consumption/home): Comprehensive household expenditure database for developing countries featuring economic and consumption data

## Environmental & Waste Management

- [What a Waste](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/what-a-waste/): Global solid waste management trends, data analysis, and environmental impact projections through 2050
